examined_formations.title: CHINA_ZHUHAI_10_FTE_SOFTWARE_COMPLETED_CONTROL_WITH_BOUNDED_PRICE_BUT_NO_RETRIEVED_CURRENT_POST_CONTROL_LEDGER_AND_PROJECT_IMPLEMENTATION
observed_actor_state_change_evidence: Shi Guangchao acquired 3,375,000 shares, 67.50% of Leyou, at RMB0.74 per share for total consideration RMB2,497,500.
The transfer completed registration on 2025-12-29; together with the acquirer's prior 2.50% position, the post-transfer holding is 70% and the controlling shareholder/actual controller changed.
The transaction therefore closes a bounded completed-control path before 2026.
objective_endowment_or_underuse_evidence: Current company profile data report 10 employees and identify software development and software services as the operating domain.
The 2025 annual report records positive revenue, positive net profit and positive operating cashflow, but almost the entire 2025 reporting year predates the 2025-12-29 control transfer.
The business pivot includes electric-power software development and telecom software outsourcing and reports project implementation cycles and contract-performance costs.
observed_behavior_or_workaround_evidence: The acquirer completed an actual controlling transfer rather than merely signing a future listing or voting arrangement.
Current low headcount makes the entity a better labor-side test than the prior project-heavy software targets.
No 2026 H1 or equivalent current post-control standalone ledger was retrieved in the evidence packet used for this scan, so post-control revenue, profit and OCF remain unclosed.
contradiction_or_partial_flow_evidence: Low FTE plus a bounded completed-control price is real, but the clean post-control economic packet is missing.
2025 positive OCF must not be promoted to post-control continuity because the transfer occurred only on December 29.
Current disclosures still describe customized software, outsourcing and project implementation cycles, so even a future positive ledger would still need a non-project recurring-revenue test.
economic_signal: 67.50% acquisition consideration RMB2.4975 million; post-transfer controller holding 70%.
2025 annual revenue/profit/OCF were positive but are not post-control evidence.
exact_incumbent_and_control_surface_pref: The controlled asset is a small software company rather than a passive physical concession or manufacturing plant.
Current software work includes project implementation and outsourcing, which may be reproducible by competing service firms unless a distinct recurring control asset is evidenced.
A current post-control report is required before any claim that the new controller inherited a durable positive cashflow position.

examined_formations.title: CHINA_CHANGZHOU_INFORMATION_TECH_51_PERCENT_CONTROL_WITH_POSITIVE_CURRENT_ACCOUNTING_AND_REPORTED_POSITIVE_OCF_BUT_113_FTE_RMB209M_CONTROL_AND_CUSTOM_HARDWARE_SERVICE
observed_actor_state_change_evidence: Shanxi Keda Automation acquired 25,500,001 shares, 51% of Haitu Technology, for RMB209.1 million.
The share transfer completed registration on 2025-12-30 and Keda remained the 51% holder at 2026-06-30.
The buyer's 2026 H1 accounting note nevertheless treats 2026-02-01 as the purchase date for combination accounting, so legal transfer timing and accounting purchase timing are preserved separately.
objective_endowment_or_underuse_evidence: Haitu operates integrated intelligent audio/video analysis products combining software algorithms, embedded modules, industrial cameras, platforms and technical services.
Buyer H1 disclosure reports target total assets about RMB242.4149 million and net assets about RMB189.6518 million.
observed_behavior_or_workaround_evidence: Target 2026 H1 revenue is RMB73.1325 million and net profit RMB16.4594 million.
A current finance-change table reports operating cashflow positive RMB3.8282 million, attributed to higher cash collections.
A separate headline per-share cashflow field surfaced inconsistently in current public data, so the OCF packet is treated as internally conflicting rather than silently choosing the favorable field.
contradiction_or_partial_flow_evidence: Even granting the positive absolute OCF table, the formation independently fails founder-light entry on 113 employees, RMB209.1 million acquisition consideration and a RMB242.4 million asset base.
The business includes custom design, manufacturing/sales of intelligent hardware and technical development/service rather than a purely repeatable software license or automated transaction rail.
Legal share-transfer completion before 2026 does not erase the buyer's February 1 accounting purchase-date treatment; exact time-window semantics must remain explicit.
economic_signal: 2026 H1 revenue RMB73.1325 million and net profit RMB16.4594 million.
Current finance-change table reports OCF positive RMB3.8282 million, with a conflicting public per-share field preserved as an evidence-quality issue.
Current FTE 113; target total assets about RMB242.4149 million.
exact_incumbent_and_control_surface_pref: The control surface includes established proprietary algorithms, hardware modules, industrial cameras, customer relationships and an operating organization.
The distinctive technology is not a generic-agent feature, but it is bundled with manufacturing/custom integration/service rather than isolated as a low-human machine transaction right.
Capital and labor dominate fresh-operator reproducibility even before OCF reconciliation is resolved.

examined_formations.title: CHINA_SHANXI_RELATED_GROUP_67_PERCENT_CONTROL_WITH_CURRENT_POSITIVE_REVENUE_PROFIT_BUT_NEGATIVE_OCF_323_FTE_AND_INDUSTRIAL_INSTALLATION
observed_actor_state_change_evidence: Taiyuan Heavy Industry acquired 67% of Taizhong Xiangming for cash consideration RMB299,515,795 and the transfer completed registration on 2025-12-31.
The transaction was a related-group restructuring: the seller Taizhong Group controls the buyer and the ultimate actual controller remained Shanxi SASAC.
Therefore formal target ownership changed, but the transfer is not evidence that an unrelated fresh small operator could reproduce the same control position.
objective_endowment_or_underuse_evidence: The buyer's 2026 H1 important-subsidiary table reports target assets RMB938.6597 million and liabilities RMB526.1560 million.
Latest disclosed/current-profile employee count is 323, not an intrinsically low workforce.
The company designs, manufactures, installs and services bulk-material conveying equipment and related engineering systems.
observed_behavior_or_workaround_evidence: The same target table reports 2026 H1 revenue RMB258.4783 million and net profit RMB6.9628 million.
Target 2026 H1 operating cashflow is explicitly negative RMB43.7289 million.
Current operating descriptions include equipment manufacturing, installation, construction/engineering and on-site technical guidance/debugging.
contradiction_or_partial_flow_evidence: Positive revenue and profit in a post-transfer target do not override deeply negative OCF.
The 323-person industrial organization and nearly RMB939 million asset base independently fail the low-labor/low-capital boundary.
Because ultimate control remained inside the same state-owned group, the deal cannot be used as evidence for fresh-independent-operator reproducibility.
economic_signal: 2026 H1 revenue RMB258.4783 million; net profit RMB6.9628 million; explicit OCF negative RMB43.7289 million.
Target assets RMB938.6597 million; latest disclosed/current-profile FTE 323.
exact_incumbent_and_control_surface_pref: The controlled position is an established industrial equipment manufacturer/engineering organization, not a narrow machine-callable transaction right.
Physical manufacturing, installation, project engineering and on-site technical work are intrinsic to delivery.
The related-group transfer changes legal ownership position without demonstrating open-market small-operator access.

excluded_observations: Scan 060-117 formations and their primary discovery signals were excluded from Scan 118 primary formation selection.

South CNC was not retained as a primary formation after current positive OCF was found because its 108-person manufacturing/R&D/sales organization and control timing mixed into H1 reproduce already-known high-labor physical delivery failure without adding a stronger low-FTE test.
Pending or intra-H1 control changes such as ST Quanhua, Haoyu, Shengzhi and Xunshang were not promoted into clean post-control evidence packets.
No job, gig, RFQ, procurement or asset-marketplace feed was used as the discovery ontology.
